provenance.description: Frozen output of one complete LAPPATO_MCB cycle per bundled demo, used to draw the README figures. Abstracts are deliberately omitted (third-party copyright); titles, ids and URLs are bibliographic facts.
provenance.procedure: python examples/demo_<tag>.py (writes the evidence CSVs), then LAPPATO_MCB(project, manifest, run_tag).run_once() online on a fresh copy of those CSVs. Retrieved sets depend on the state of arXiv, OpenAlex and Crossref on that date.

Chosen model is justified by performance stability, not only mean score.

cards.title: Residual variance grows across rolling-origin folds
queries: GARCH heteroscedasticity time series volatility clustering
log transform variance stabilisation forecasting time series
cards.why_it_matters: Growing residual variance means point errors and uncertainty are not exchangeable across time; this harms interval coverage and risk-aware forecasting.
next_checks: Plot residual variance by rolling-origin fold.
Compare log/Box-Cox transforms.
Test a GARCH residual model after the mean forecaster.
success_criteria: Last/first residual variance ratio falls below 1.5.
Prediction interval empirical coverage approaches the target level.
